title: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Raspberry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Raspberry Ice pairs two vibrant red fruits with a cooling layer of Menthol for a crisp and flavourful vape. The sweet, jammy notes of Strawberry meet the tart brightness of Raspberry, while the icy finish gives each puff a clean, cooling edge that refreshes the palate. Made with nicotine salts for a faster, smoother nicotine hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend ensures well-defined flavour with discreet vapour throughout the day. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
